svg.text: Apple-native consistency pass generated from official Apple Design Resources and Figma UI-kit links. Chrome is quiet; the graph is the only spatial object.
One shell, one sidebar, one toolbar cluster, one inspector language.
A local graph of your life, with editable articles as the readable layer.
Primary content column uses SF Pro controls and New York prose.
Inspectors open from the right and always include Close/Archive/Forget.
No source filenames, raw domains, or bare nouns on primary surfaces.

Clear close button, evidence path, open wiki, archive, forget.
Evidence intake, not a file manager. Default list is clustered by intent.
Evidence stays separate from memory. Clusters show intent; details stay in the inspector.
The app summarizes after extraction; no filenames are primary text.
memory compiler, wiki, graph, YC demo
Shows hidden raw pages only after selection.
Editable authored articles. User edits are canonical truth.
The user is a UCLA mathematics student. The article merges identity, coursework, and active academic constraints into one readable page.
The user is managing UCLA coursework and needs current classes, deadlines, and academic identity treated as active memory.
Only appears when the hive needs clarification, not as source clutter.
Base graph is wordless. Hover/selection opens meaning; edges are straight.
The user is researching grants and scholarships for a more powerful Mac.
Search temporarily reveals labels; clearing search returns to wordless graph.
Same controls, same status language, no raw dumps.
What Mac am I trying to buy?
You are looking for funding to buy a more powerful Mac, preferably an M3 Ultra Mac Studio with 512GB RAM.
What should Hive never learn about?
Animations explain cause: import, synthesize, select, navigate.
symbol bounce, source row slides in
claim fades into Wiki and graph node appears
Wiki Show in Hive centers and selects node
Reduced motion keeps ordering and final state through opacity/tint changes. No idle animation, no graph mouse-following.
